criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Nine distinct techniques and real light and dark on most frames. Slide 8 is the best thing here and a reader gets it in a second. Slide 5's inversion and slide 6's intaglio both land. Slide 9's patch reads at 432px as an out of focus brown smear and the type carries the whole frame. Slide 2's five assemblies read as one ring at five decreasing scales.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every on slide and caption numeral traces, sources are primary throughout, ten rejected findings each with a stated reason, c18's quote corrected to restore the dropped footnote marker and the confidence upgrade documented by a direct 639,984 byte fetch rather than asserted. Deductions: c10 is confidence medium and its truncated quote is slide 3's dek, and the topics ledger still carries without imported rare earths.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A reader learns four true, checkable things and the stake is concrete rather than abstract, which is more than the rubric's 7 asks. Nothing to do: no county, no date, no door, and slide 4 is the only frame naming the deciding body.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: A real build and a real turn at slide 5, which supplies the join the deck needs. Slide 5 states its turn line beneath the source credit and under a quote that already said it. The last two frames are both negatives.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Four good headlines and none reads as machine written. No boosterism, no doom, and slide 8's dek is exactly the register this product wants. What it has none of is regional specificity, and the three hashtags carry no Texas or Houston tag at all.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Nine camera classes, no repeat, dark bench palette against the last fortnight, the ochre stock deliberately avoiding three consecutive creams. Opening move and structure both outside the six run window. Deck 11 seven days ago was also a federal research award to a Texas university closing on a partner list.

one_sentence_fix: Open the caption on what the cover already leads with rather than on a $20,000 difference between two press releases.
